snapshot.title: STARTEX: System Start — Sunday, October 24, 2026

fields.location: Riverside Water Treatment Plant, Millbrook, Ohio
fields.load: Normal: 14.2 MGD throughput, 92% of design capacity
fields.staffing: Full shifts in Operations, SCADA, Water Quality, and IT Security
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 07:00 on a quiet Sunday morning at the Riverside Water Treatment Plant. The system is operating normally, with no active alarms, no reported incidents, and all critical personnel on duty. The water quality is within compliance, and the distribution network is stable. The exercise begins now.

status.name: Plant Overview (OVW-1)
status.note: All flows nominal, AIT-301 to AIT-304 within limits

status.name: Chemical Feed (CHM-2)
status.note: CL2-FC-201/202, NAOH-FC-203, F-FC-204, ALUM-FC-205, POLY-FC-206 in automatic mode, bulk tank levels above 60%

status.name: Clearwell / High Service (CLW-4)
status.note: LIT-401/402 at 32.4 ft and 32.1 ft, HSP-1 to HSP-3 running normally

status.name: Distribution Overview (DST-5)
status.note: Zones 1–3 pressure stable, Hilltop Tank at 41.7 ft, Northgate Reservoir at 36.2 ft

status.name: Water Quality (WQ-Status)
status.note: All finished water AITs within 0.2–0.6 mg/L residual, no violations

status.name: Security (SEC-10)
status.note: All RTUs and PLCs show active comms, no unauthorized remote sessions

status.name: Public Alerts (MBW-EWS-01)
status.note: MillbrookAlert and outage map show no active advisories

fields.facilitatorNote: Confirm all roles have their player packets and that the control board is set to normal. This inject establishes baseline operational stability for the incident scenario.
